##: AVX512 build only. Chromium mini_installer stub: the real payload is an embedded chrome.7z (Chrome-bin/) inside the .exe. Upstream's own installer wants admin + writes to Program Files, so this manifest carves the payload out and unpacks it into the scoop dir instead — no admin, nothing outside $dir. Same binary as the portable zip, just a different shape.
description: Thorium 浏览器（安装版，Chromium 分支，AVX512 优化构建）
notes: 本 manifest 只收录 AVX512 构建；AVX2/AVX/SSE4/SSE3/SSE2-win32/ARM64 未收录
上游 mini_installer 默认装到 Program Files 且要管理员，这里改为抽出内嵌 chrome.7z 解包到 scoop 目录，不需要管理员权限
浏览器用户数据在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Thorium（Scoop 不接管，升级与卸载都不会动它）
这是安装版；要免安装的绿色版请装 thorium-AVX512-Portable

script: if (-not (Test-Path "$dir\chrome.7z")) { error 'Could not find the embedded chrome.7z inside $fname' }
